names.note: The calendar’s own name page for him, which day-candidates.mjs prints as `name: Владимир (Алексеев), иерей, сщмч.`; the grade and the rank are stripped and the surname kept, the day line itself declining the bare forename only. `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE.

death.note: The year the day line closes with, «(1918)», which is the whole of what the source gives; no year of birth and no reading of his own.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 16 декабря ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Владимира (1918).»

attestations.note: The day’s sixth entry, and THE LINE AND THE NAME PAGE ARE ALL THERE IS: no life page stands behind it. The line gives the bare forename and the name page the surname and the grade, «иерей», priest. No folder held him: `fk.mjs` on «Владимир (Алексеев)» returns NONE. He is the earliest of the day’s new martyrs by nineteen years and belongs to no company; the seven of the next line are of 1937. `new-martyr` is written as this corpus writes it for this calendar’s twentieth-century «сщмч.» entries, AND THE 26 ЯНВАРЯ SYNAXIS PAGE WAS NOT OPENED. The day page carries two hymns, both under another saint’s name.
